answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a pipeline-based data augmentation method using LLM to enhance data diversity in sentence representation learning.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate model performance with Spearman's correlation on semantic textual similarity (STS) tasks, not on generated text quality.

answer_3.quote: We use a frozen evaluation model to filter synthetic data, rather than employing an LLM to judge the generated sentences.
